# Code Context

## Files Retrieved
1. `SingleThread/ContentView.swift` (lines 1-84) — the entire list interface in one file.
2. `SingleThread/Item.swift` (lines 13-22) — the `@Model` type; single property `timestamp: Date`.
3. `SingleThread/SingleThreadApp.swift` (lines 12-27) — model container/schema wiring.

## Key Findings (Q2)

**NavigationViewWrapper abstraction** (`ContentView.swift:65-79`): a `private struct NavigationViewWrapper<Content: View>` taking a `content: () -> Content` closure. On macOS it emits a `NavigationSplitView { content() } detail: { Text("Select an item") }` (lines 70-74); on iOS/visionOS (`#else`) it returns `content()` unchanged (line 76).

**Body / list construction** (`ContentView.swift:14-42`): `body` wraps a `List` in `NavigationViewWrapper`. The `List` contains a `ForEach(items)` of `NavigationLink`s.

**Row rendering** (`ContentView.swift:18-22`): each row is a `NavigationLink` whose label is `Text(item.timestamp, format: Date.FormatStyle(date: .numeric, time: .standard))`. The destination is `Text("Item at \(item.timestamp, format: ...)")` using the same format. **Each row shows only the item's `timestamp`** — nothing else, because `Item` has only a `timestamp: Date` property (`Item.swift:21`).

**Toolbar** (`ContentView.swift:29-40`): iOS-only `EditButton` in `.navigationBarTrailing` (lines 30-34); plus an `Add Item` `Label`/`Button` (lines 35-39) that calls `addItem`.

**Data sources** (`ContentView.swift:46-47`): `@Environment(\.modelContext)` and `@Query private var items: [Item]`. `addItem` inserts `Item(timestamp: Date())`; `deleteItems` deletes by `IndexSet` — both inside `withAnimation` (lines 49-62).

**macOS column width** (lines 26-28): `.navigationSplitViewColumnWidth(min: 180, ideal: 200)`.
